title: Cad End to End
description: Get cad working end to end: model definitions (typologies, actions, interactions, attribute/property definitions, transformations) load and validate, the runtime executes construct actions, interactions drive the renderer state machine, model spaces link primitives across model definitions, and all cad extensions (spatial-shape, aec-building, aec-building-structure, aec-building-energy) contribute working typologies.
summary:
CAD now works end to end in the TypeScript runtime: 371 tsc errors → 0 in CAD, and the test suite went from "8 of 9 files fail to load, 1 test runs" to 321/321 passing across 9 files.

Two silent bugs were actually stopping CAD.

1. Asset discovery was dead. The 12 `import.meta.glob` patterns in `…/✏️editor/⚙️engine/🏃️runtime/🟦️component.ts` were off by five directory levels (`../../../../` landed on `🪆️subsets`; reaching the plugin root needs nine). Every glob returned `{}`, so all model definitions, typologies, actions, interactions and transformations on disk were invisible to the runtime and `registerModelDefinitionAssets()` registered nothing. Nothing errored — discovery just returned zero. Fixing the globs took the suite from 1 test running to 321.

2. Every interaction effect no-opped. The authoritative Rust schema (`🎬️interaction-spec/🦀️component.rs:234`) tags the effect enum `#[serde(tag = "mutation")]` and all 49 shipped interaction assets emit `{"mutation": "assign", …}`, but the TS `EffectSpec` union and its consumers discriminated on `.operation`, which is never present. So assign/clear/append/kernel.query/action/interaction.call all did nothing: interaction context stayed `{}`, commit guards failed, and no interaction ever reached `committed`. Renamed the discriminator to `mutation` (schema-first) and repaired the 13 consumer sites tsc then flagged — 45 tests went green at once. `"operation"` remains correct for action steps; the 88 action JSONs genuinely use it.

Also fixed: `@semio-tech/s-3d-js` was unresolvable repo-wide (a concurrent consolidation left its package `exports` pointing outside its own package directory — 19 TS2307 plus cascades, and `PRIMITIVE_MODEL_ENTITY_KINDS` undefined at runtime); an import-cycle TDZ on `MODEL_ENTITY_KINDS`; three wrong relative paths left by the same consolidation; `core` exported as a value where extensions needed a namespace; renderer tests never had a DOM (`environmentMatchGlobs` does not exist in vitest 4, so it silently no-opped); `command.addSelection` ignored the `key` parameter chamfer/fillet rely on; and retired 14-verb mutation vocabularies in the binary protocol and text grammar regenerated against the current 20 `CadMutation::KINDS`.

Implemented 13 kernel geometry operations that previously had no implementation at all in `BrepjsWasmEngine.executeCommandDiff`: `solid.boolean{Union,Difference,Intersection}` (real OpenCascade booleans), `surface.{plane,loft,sweep1,sweep2,networkSrf}` and `edit.{join,explode,chamfer,fillet,split,trim}`, adding three facade primitives (`cut`, `intersect`, `sweep`) behind the existing opaque-handle interface so no brepjs type leaks out. Authored construct kits for the 11 `aec.building.*` typologies after confirming no transformation targets `aec.building` — it is only ever a transformation source, so those typologies were genuinely missing constructors rather than being transformation-derived.

Closed the `flow_core` wasm gap: it never exported `tessellate`/`dispose` via `#[wasm_bindgen]`, which would have broken CAD's brep tessellation path at runtime. Added a wasm32-gated bridge module and regenerated the pack; both are now real exports in `pkg/flow_core.{js,d.ts}`.

Assets now loading: 9 model definitions, 38 typologies, 97 actions, 60 interactions, 10 transformations.

NOT VERIFIED — blocked by a concurrent session, not by CAD:
- CAD's Rust crate cannot be built or tested. `semio-s-plugin-cad` depends on `semio-s-plugin-stdio`, which another session is mid-refactor on (6256 modified paths and climbing, 329 compile errors). Repeated `cargo build -p semio-s-plugin-cad --keep-going` runs show the only failing crate is `semio-s-plugin-stdio`; zero errors originate in CAD's own Rust sources. Left untouched deliberately.
- No live-app runtime proof. `bun ./📜️script.ts dev cad` reports `program build scope: cad, stdio` and then blocks on the shared cargo build-directory lock, so it needs the broken crate. The machine is saturated by other sessions (load average 115, 67 concurrent cargo/rustc). All evidence in this ticket is from the test suite and typechecker, not from the running app.
- `mutate-cad-1` subject/parity phases need the Rust build. Its independent Python oracle did run and passed 41/41 (20 mutate + 20 inverse + 1 identity round-trip), with no drift between the Rust enum, the oracle, the feature file and the registry.

Known gap left open (missing feature, not a regression, no test covers it): `ModelSpace` carries the hash primitives `vertexHashesByModel`/`geometryHashesByModel` that AGENTS.md's linked-editing semantics require — edit propagation across models sharing a primitive hash, plus the warning when models can no longer be linked — but nothing consumes them yet. Deserves its own ticket.

The one remaining repo-wide tsc error is in `🦑️repo/…/📚️library/…/📦️index.ts`, a file another session is actively editing (it moved from line 6083 to 6114 mid-session); untouched by this ticket.
